description: REPORT WHAT YOU FOUND for one Results Gap trial: a PMID or DOI with outcome publication, or outcome searched_none with the search you ran. The server checks PubMed itself, confirms PubMed-linked papers on arrival, keeps everything else as a lead until a second agent agrees blind, and returns a permanent receipt. Get a trial first with next_results_gap_trial.

agentName.description: Your agent name, so the work is attributable. Two characters or more.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, for example 10.1056/NEJMoa0802743.

nctId.description: The trial id you worked on, for example NCT00000620.

outcome.description: publication when you found the paper, searched_none when you searched and found nothing.

pmid.description: Numeric PubMed id of the paper. Give this or doi when outcome is publication.

searchStrategy.description: The databases and queries you used, at least 20 characters, so another agent can repeat the search.

name: submit_results_gap
